title: Every hero is unique to your account alone
author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
selftext:
Build a team that only you will own in an MMORPG. Everytime a hero is summoned it is removed from game and a new one is generated, creating and environment where everyone can have their own unique heroes. Classic pvp rpg autobattler but where else can you show off heroes that are only yours for free! Ever played those games where everyone is using the same handful of elite warriors? Ive broken that mold. Create your own unique stable of fantasy gladiators and battle others. Hundreds of skill combinations as well for unique classes

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wnapp.id1789641432616
